title: How To Do Pirouettes, Fouettés, and À La Seconde Turns! I Dance Turn Tutorial with @trainwithkendall

method.teacher_system: The teacher breaks down advanced dance turns into simple, isolated anatomical cues and clear positional steps. She introduces each turn type progressively, demonstrating common mistakes alongside correct alignment and emphasizing postural control like closing the ribcage. Learners practice each preparatory position static before attempting rotations, building muscle memory piece by piece.
method.signature: She introduces a slap prep motion to lock in momentum and structure before attempting à la seconde turns.

practices.what: Demonstrates the foot placement and arm position for parallel pirouette prep.
Shows correct knee alignment over toes during plie to prevent overextension.
Explains closing the ribcage by engaging lower abs and flattening the spine.
Combines lower body plie to passe transition with matching arm movements.
Shows a loss of balance to demonstrate how not to turn.
Explains how to engage deep outward rotators for ballet turn out.
Demonstrates keeping the outside arm slightly in front of the body.
Emphasizes keeping a high passe to maintain rotational momentum.
Introduces the slap prep into pirouette prep position for second turns.
Teaches holding the leg extension at the corner before adding rotation.
Instructs keeping the extended leg at a constant height without swinging.
Breaks down fouette preparation into front, side, and passe positions.

adaptations.difficulty: Practicing turns without a studio ballet barre
adaptations.adjustment: Use a household chair to hold onto for balance.

struggles.theme: Losing balance during pirouettes and turning over
Difficulty holding leg high enough for second turns
Hitting surrounding furniture in a small room

clicked.theme: Understanding how to close the ribcage properly
Clear step-by-step breakdown of turning mechanics

method.limits: The provided video cuts off at 10:00 while explaining fouette turns on releve at the barre.
